STEP 9. Check the harness wires between washer motor 
connector A-33 and front-ECU connector A-09X.
NOTE: After checking intermediate connector C-06, check the 
wires. If intermediate connector C-06 is damaged, repair or 
replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness Connector 
Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between washer motor connector 
A-33 and front-ECU connector A-09X in good condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair them. The windshield washer should work 
normally.
